section.title: Install pmMDA
section.p: The binary distribution of pmMDA is delivered as a compressed file. Unzip the file at your preferred location. ZIP files can be opened using various open source tools. All required libraries are contained in the archive file.
The installation does not need any additional steps. No environment variables or registry modifications are required.
If you want to uninstall pmMDA distribution simply delete the directory containing the files.

section.title: Run pmMDA
section.p: The script file pmMDA.bat starts the application. The user interface allows the user to open an existing model and edit it.

section.title: Customise Generator Templates
section.p: All generator templates are written in Velocity. All features of Velocity can be used. The items available in the context are documented in the generators documentation. Each cartridge roles, supported tagged values, attributes and properties are documented. This description is also available on the project web site.
